component.name: D2RLoader
component.summary: Launch and manage several Diablo II: Resurrected accounts

description.p: D2RLoader starts Diablo II: Resurrected for several Battle.net accounts at once, each in a wineprefix of its own through umu and Proton. Steam accounts are handed to the Steam client.
It also shows the current terror zones and the Diablo Clone progress.
